subject: Vendor registration preflight + PO 3492 — AP onboarding checklist
messages:
From: Claire Miller <claire.miller@clearmounthealth.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-20T09:12:00Z
Subject: Onboarding: vendor registration + PO requirements (possible EU VAT)

Hi Jasmine,

We're starting vendor setup on our side for Redwood Inference. We're preparing PO #3492 and want to confirm your AP requirements so the invoice routes cleanly and pays on the first scheduled run. A few things we need from you: 

- Official vendor legal name + remit address as you want it on the invoice
- VAT registration / EU tax evidence (we handle reverse-charge in some cases) — do you have a standard VAT certificate or EU excise docs we should store?
- Preferred invoice format (PDF/EDI/Peppol) and required fields (PO number location, invoice reference, GL code mapping if any)
- Banking details (beneficiary name, IBAN, SWIFT) or third-party payment provider if you use one
- Are there any special payment terms for this account (net30/net45/early pay)?
- Are you set up in our supplier portal? If not, we will invite you — do you need an onboarding packet?

We're trying to collect everything so the AP team can process the first invoice without exceptions. Can you send the AP packet and a sample invoice template that includes the PO number placement?

Thanks,
Claire Miller
Procurement Manager
ClearMount Health
procurement@clearmounthealth.com

[Attachment: none]

From: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
To: Claire Miller <claire.miller@clearmounthealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-21T10:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Onboarding: vendor registration + PO requirements (possible EU VAT)

Hi Claire — thanks for the heads up. Below is a concise preflight checklist and the next steps to avoid AP exceptions on PO 3492. I've attached our AP_onboarding_packet and a sample invoice template.

Required vendor profile fields (please ensure these map into your portal):
- Legal name: Redwood Inference, Inc.
- Remit address: 1201 Mission St, San Francisco, CA 94103, USA
- VAT/Tax ID: EU VAT: GB999999973 (if reverse-charge applies we'll provide the certificate)
- Billing contact: billing@redwood.com (for invoice queries)
- Preferred remittance: Bank transfer (IBAN/SWIFT below) OR Stripe/Adyen for card/ACH (we can accept both)

Bank details (for direct transfer):
- Beneficiary: Redwood Inference, Inc.
- IBAN: GB29RBIN00001234567890
- SWIFT: RBINGB2L

Invoice formatting notes (to prevent PO mismatch):
- Put the customer PO number in the invoice top-right and in the filename, e.g., invoice_PO3492.pdf
- Include line-level PO references if multiple PO lines exist
- Use the attached sample_invoice_template.xlsx for GL / cost-center mapping (column H = your PO)

Tax / VAT handling:
- We can provide a VAT certificate (attached as VAT_certificate_evidence.pdf). For EU reverse-charge: please apply reverse-charge where applicable and confirm on the invoice that "VAT reverse charge applied per Article 194."

Portal and EDI:
- We support PDF invoices and Peppol/EDIFACT EDI. If you want automated e-invoicing, confirm Peppol ID and we'll supply our endpoint. Otherwise, PDFs by email to billing@redwood.com are fine.

Attachments included: AP_onboarding_packet.pdf (required fields + sample CSV you can import), sample_invoice_template.xlsx, VAT_certificate_evidence.pdf

Next steps:
1) Please share the supplier portal invite (if you plan to enroll us in your portal) or provide the portal registration link.
2) Confirm payment term you will apply to PO 3492 (we typically accept net30).
3) If you need a W-9 / W-8BEN-E for tax withholding we can send appropriate forms (we're US-registered but have EU subsidiaries).

Marissa (cc) will confirm commercial terms and any early-pay options.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Partner Ops 
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: AP_onboarding_packet.pdf, sample_invoice_template.xlsx, VAT_certificate_evidence.pdf]
